VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: copy
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Copy — Yuta Okkotsu's cursed technique, through Rika. With Rika fully manifested, she eats part of a sorcerer and Yuta gains their techniques. Also: Rika's partial manifestations, the techniques he copied in the Culling Game, and his domain, Authentic Mutual Love.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Rika Orimoto died when she and Yuta were children, and became the curse that haunted him. What she is now, he made: a reserve of cursed energy beyond anyone's, and the technique to take anyone else's.

VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: cursed speech
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Cursed Speech — the Inumaki clan's inherited technique. Words charged with cursed energy become commands the listener can't refuse. The stronger the listener, the less a command does to them and the more it costs the speaker.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Toge Inumaki speaks only in rice ball fillings, so no stray word becomes a command. Every command strains his throat. Yuta, who copied it, takes no strain at all.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.lockedReason: Yuta Okkotsu and Toge Inumaki only

HediffDef.label: vast cursed energy
HediffDef.description: A reserve of cursed energy beyond anyone's: Yuta Okkotsu's own, or lent by his ring. Psycasts cost a fifth of the usual psyfocus, and psyfocus refills on its own, about a fifth of the bar every hour.
